symptom: prettier 3.6.2's PostCSS printer crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')' in plugins/postcss.mjs on a declaration whose value is (or begins with) a bare comma. The upstream report used a custom property spliced into a gradient (--l: , ...; radial-gradient(... var(--l))); shrink ray reduces it to the essential trigger, a declaration like '0:,'. Fixed by PR #17899 in a later release; current prettier formats it cleanly.
